rationale: Positives: The agent properly authenticated the user (name + zip), identified the correct order with the jigsaw, presented valid alternative options, obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the pending order, executed the item change correctly, and accurately reported the refund amount and method per tool output. Issues: The user requested an address correction. The agent stated it would update the shipping address for the order, but only executed modify_user_address (profile-level) and did not perform or show any tool call to update the shipping address on order #W4082615 (or the other pending order). The final message claimed the shipping address was updated, which is unsupported by the tools, and the last seen order details still show the old address. This constitutes incomplete execution and incorrect final information per policy requirements.
